held_out_contract.rule: No turn of this set, and no near-duplicate of one, may appear in any training corpus. The corpus pipeline's admission check dedupes every candidate against exactly this file before admission; a detected overlap voids the run's gate results until the corpus is corrected.
held_out_contract.versioning: The sha256 of this file's bytes is the fixture version recorded with gate results (author_chat_golden.evidence()).
